questions.evidence:
COLLECTION LOG: A brass bell was donated by Ms. Lin in 2014. A wooden kite frame came from Mr. Chen in 2018. A clay bowl was donated by Ms. Wu in 2014. These are the only three objects on the demonstration table today.

LABEL PROBLEM: During cleaning, their loose labels were mixed up. One label still shows Mr. Chen and 2018. A second shows Ms. Lin, but its year is covered by a stain. The third shows only 2014 because its donor's name has been rubbed away.

STUDENT PLAN: Match each label with the collection log before attaching it. Do not match by year alone when two objects share a year. The bell and bowl have the same arrival year but different donors, materials, and uses.

The students first identify the kite frame, then the bell using Ms. Lin's name. The remaining label belongs to the bowl. Before displaying it, they make a replacement that restores Ms. Wu's name from the log and note that the old label was damaged.
